summary: Master real estate investment analysis with our comprehensive training course. Gain the skills to make informed decisions and maximize your returns today!
lede: Real estate investment analysis evaluates property cash flows, valuation, financing and risk to guide acquisition, hold, repositioning or exit decisions. For professionals working with property data, investment cases or financing, the course covers cash-flow and discounted-cash-flow modelling, IRR and cap-rate interpretation, and financing comparisons in Excel. Learners also practise stress-testing downside scenarios and turning evidence into investment memos and portfolio scorecards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with property data, investment cases, or financing discussions and need a more disciplined approach to real estate investment analysis.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel installed and a working ability to open, edit, and save spreadsheets. Prior exposure to property cash flow statements, valuation terms, and basic investment metrics will help you move faster through the exercises.
